mapper.sql: id, organization_code, organization_name, organization_type, parent_id, is_enabled, valid_from, valid_to, created_at, updated_at, row_version
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO org_organization ( organization_code, organization_name, organization_type, parent_id, is_enabled, valid_from, valid_to, created_by, updated_by ) VALUES ( #{organizationCode}, #{organizationName}, #{organizationType}, #{parentId}, 1, #{validFrom}, #{validTo}, #{actor}, #{actor} )
mapper.update: UPDATE org_organization SET organization_name = #{command.organizationName}, organization_type = #{command.organizationType}, parent_id = #{command.parentId}, valid_from = #{command.validFrom}, valid_to = #{command.validTo}, updated_by = #{actor}, updated_at = SYSUTCDATETIME() WHERE id = #{id} AND row_version = #{command.expectedVersion}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM org_organization WHERE parent_id = #{parentId} AND is_enabled = 1
